tool_schemas.name: list_invoices
tool_schemas.description: List invoices, optionally for one vendor (by vendor name).

tool_schemas.name: send_wire
tool_schemas.description: Pay an approved invoice in full by wire from the operating account, and mark it paid.

idempotency_key.description: Optional client-supplied key. Requests repeated with the same key are executed at most once.

tool_schemas.name: send_ach
tool_schemas.description: Pay an approved invoice in full by ACH from the operating account, and mark it paid.

idempotency_key.description: Optional client-supplied key. Requests repeated with the same key are executed at most once.

tool_schemas.name: list_payments
tool_schemas.description: List payments sent from the operating account.

tool_schemas.name: link_payment
tool_schemas.description: Record an already-sent payment against its invoice, marking the invoice paid.

Payment complete. ✅

**Payment details**
- **Vendor:** Fjord Analytics (V-352, bank verified, wire rail)
- **Invoice:** INV-47201 — the only approved invoice on the account
- **Amount paid:** **$1,312.90** by **wire** from the operating account
- **Payment ID:** PAY0001
- **Status:** sent; invoice now marked **paid**

**Note on the amount:** The invoice was originally $1,427.07, but my first payment attempt was rejected because the balance had changed — credit memo CM-7201 (−$114.17) had been applied, bringing the balance to $1,312.90. I re-read the invoice and paid the corrected balance in full. Exactly one payment was sent (idempotency key `pay-INV-47201-V352-once`), and the payment ledger confirms a single payment of $1,312.90.

The other two Fjord Analytics invoices were left untouched: INV-35948 is already paid, and INV-80095 ($8,937.35) is still in draft awaiting approval. No approval escalation was needed since the payment was well under the $10,000 controller threshold.
